title: Raamatupidamise seadus (Accounting Act, RPS): § 24 to § 24², § 31 to § 31² and § 61³ (management report, sustainability report, corporate governance report, consolidated equivalents, transitional rules)
citation: Raamatupidamise seadus, adopted 2002-11-20, RT I 2002, 102, 600; consolidated text group 155849; sustainability report duty in § 24 lg 2 inserted by RT I, 07.01.2025, 1
evidence: Riigi Teataja version list https://www.riigiteataja.ee/public-api/api/v1/akt/155849/redaktsioonid (opened 2026-11-02): the first version of the Accounting Act (id 229287) has kehtivuseAlgus 2003-01-01 and already contains § 24. The sustainability-report duty is in force from 2025-01-17 (see ee-rps-amendment-2025).
notes: Record text is the cut of §§ 24, 24¹, 24², 31, 31¹, 31² and 61³ (the paragraphs that carry the management report, the kestlikkusaruanne and the ühingujuhtimise aruanne duties); § 3 definitions (ESRS) and the rest of the Act are not stored. 14 records, 2003-01-01 to 2025-07-01 (27 versions served, 2003-01-01 to 2027-01-01). The version of 2027-01-01 (RT I, 11.07.2026, 9) is a published amendment not yet in force; its cut equals the 2025-07-01 text, so it has no record. The sustainability-report wording first appears in the 2025-01-17 record. Amended by ee-rps-amendment-2025. Records are consolidated texts of Riigi Teataja, stored only where the cut text differs from the previous stored version (the dates are the dates the cut text changed); headings and paragraphs are one line each, amendment notes are kept as bracketed lines in the Riigi Teataja form, superscript numbers are written with Unicode superscript digits. English: Riigi Teataja serves a translation for 13 of the Estonian versions (earliest 2011-01-01, latest 2025-07-20) but the row EE-RT-TRANSLATION is permission requested (the site calls the translations unofficial; no live page grants reuse), so no English record is stored. English translations were not checked for amendment state because none is stored.

title: Raamatupidamise seaduse muutmise ja sellest tulenevalt teiste seaduste muutmise seadus (Directive (EU) 2022/2464 transposition; amends the Accounting Act and other acts)
citation: RT I, 07.01.2025, 1; adopted by the Riigikogu 2024-12-17, promulgated 2024-12-23
evidence: Riigi Teataja public API https://www.riigiteataja.ee/public-api/api/v1/akt/107012025001 (opened 2026-11-02): aktiParameetrid.kehtivuseAlgus 2025-01-16T22:00:00Z, which is 2025-01-17 in Estonia; the XML metadata reads <kehtivuseAlgus>2025-01-17+02:00</kehtivuseAlgus>. The act text has no section on entry into force.
notes: The existing register row for this act (found through the EU Publications Office measures list) is updated in place. The act is stored as published (one record, Estonian). It amends the Accounting Act (ee-rps), the Audiitortegevuse seadus (assurance of the sustainability report, § 13 lg 1 p 1 public-interest entities), the Väärtpaberituru seadus and the Töötajate usaldusisiku seadus; the consolidated Audiitortegevuse seadus is not in scope. The Riigi Teataja consolidated texts that carry the amendments are 107012025011 (Accounting Act, in force 2025-01-17) and 107012025013 (Audiitortegevuse seadus). No later Estonian act changing the sustainability-report scope for the EU Omnibus (Directive (EU) 2026/470) was found in Riigi Teataja on 2026-11-02 (title search 'Raamatupidamise seaduse' among published acts). No English translation: an as-published act has none.

title: Tarbijakaitseseadus (Consumer Protection Act, TKS): § 2 terms, §§ 13 to 18¹ unfair commercial practices (kauplemisvõtted, including environmental claims), and § 70 liability
citation: Tarbijakaitseseadus, adopted 2015-12-09, RT I, 31.12.2015, 1; consolidated text group 1032300; environmental-claims rules inserted by RT I, 03.07.2026, 19
evidence: § 85 Seaduse jõustumine: "Käesolev seadus jõustub 2016. aasta 1. märtsil." Opened https://www.riigiteataja.ee/public-api/api/v1/akt/131122015001/xml on 2026-11-02 (the first version, in force 2016-03-01).
notes: The brief named §§ 12 to 16; in the current numbering the unfair-practices rules are Division 2 of Chapter 3 (§§ 13 to 18¹, with § 15 ebaaus and § 16 eksitav kauplemisvõte; § 16¹ on substantiation of claims), so the cut is § 2 (terms, which since 2026 define keskkonnaväide, üldine keskkonnaväide, kestlikkusmärgis), Division 2, and § 70 (fine for breaching the ban). The Act has no 'green claims' section other than these. 6 records, 2016-03-01 to 2026-09-27 (23 versions served, 2016-03-01 to 2026-09-27). The 2026-07-13 and 2026-09-27 records come from ee-tks-2024-825-act; the 2026-09-27 text is the current one. title: Tarbijakaitseseaduse ja lõhkematerjaliseaduse muutmise seadus (transposes Directive (EU) 2024/825, empowering consumers for the green transition; amends the Consumer Protection Act)
citation: RT I, 03.07.2026, 19; adopted by the Riigikogu 2026-06-17, promulgated 2026-06-29
evidence: Riigi Teataja public API https://www.riigiteataja.ee/public-api/api/v1/akt/103072026019 (opened 2026-11-02): kehtivuseAlgus 2026-07-12T21:00:00Z, which is 2026-07-13 in Estonia; § 3 Seaduse jõustumine: "Käesoleva seaduse § 1 punktid 1–8 ning 15 ja 16 jõustuvad 2026. aasta 27. septembril." (the environmental-claims points are in that group; the Directive applies from 2026-09-27).
notes: Stored as published (one record, Estonian), dated 2026-07-13, the first in-force date of the act; its § 1 points 1–8, 15 and 16 apply from 2026-09-27. The act's own text names the Directive only through the consolidated Tarbijakaitseseadus (reference list), which cites Directive (EU) 2024/825. The Võlaõigusseaduse ja tarbijakaitseseaduse muutmise seadus RT I, 27.05.2026, 2 (in force 2026-09-01) amends the TKS for another Directive and is not in scope. No English translation: an as-published act has none.
